map.Fox(220−年龄)最经典但个体差异大；Tanaka(208−0.7age)、: Fox(220 - age) is the classic formula but varies a lot between individuals; Tanaka(208 - 0.7age), Gellish(207 - 0.7age) and Arena(209 - 0.6age) are more modern regressions and generally run 1-5 bpm above Fox.
